title: 1977 AHSME Problem 15
statement: Each of the three circles in the adjoining figure is externally tangent to the other two, and each side of the triangle is tangent to two of the circles. If each circle has radius three, then the perimeter of the triangle is

solutions.text:
The circle centers form an equilateral triangle of side \(6,\) whose inradius is \(\frac{6\sqrt3}{6}=\sqrt3.\) Each side of the outer triangle is a parallel tangent line three units farther out, so the outer triangle has inradius \(3+\sqrt3.\) An equilateral triangle of inradius \(r\) has side \(2\sqrt3r,\) hence each outer side is \[ 2\sqrt3(3+\sqrt3)=6+6\sqrt3. \] The perimeter is \(3(6+6\sqrt3)=18+18\sqrt3.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: The three circle centers form an equilateral triangle of side \(6\)
View the outer sides as parallel offsets and compare the inradii of two equilateral triangles
